title: Rick Rubin — rich

pieces.file: Rick Rubin — rich — clear away what hides it.m4a
pieces.title: Clear away what hides it
pieces.caption: Eight layers at once. One leaves each bar: shaker, arpeggio, pad, second guitar, drums, bass. What is left is a voice and one guitar, which were playing the whole time. *What is real and what is a choice:* Synthesized, including the 'voice', which is a buzz through two formants. Nothing is added after bar one. *Leaking in:* Dub Lineage: subtraction again, but only ever in one direction.
